integrity: The all-parameter polynomial and unimodality proofs are symbolic. Exhaustive subset enumeration for every parameter pair with \(3\le r,s\le7\) checks the polynomial independently; formula-based checks through \(3\le r\le s\le40\) corroborate the unimodality classification. Neither finite check is treated as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard connected strong alliance polynomial for dumbbells with both clique orders at least three. The founding arXiv full text and a later open full text were inspected for definitions, family coverage, and target-family terminology. An unindexed or differently named family-specific result remains a residual literature risk.
title: Strong alliance polynomial of dumbbell graphs
